high_level_description: The image depicts a close-up of an hourglass, which is a device used to measure the passage of time. The hourglass consists of two glass bulbs connected by a narrow neck, through which sand or small beads can flow from one bulb to the other. In this particular image, the sand is visible in the lower bulb, indicating that time is passing. The hourglass itself appears to be made of dark wood, with the bulbs and the connecting neck being transparent. The sand inside the bulbs is white, creating a stark contrast against the dark wood and the clear glass.
